source.text: Harriet Orcutt Duleep (born 1953) is a Research Professor with The Thomas Jefferson Program in Public Policy of the College of William and Mary. She was a daughter of economist Guy Orcutt and is sister to economist Alice Nakamura.
source.title: Harriet Orcutt Duleep

source.text: Guy Henderson Orcutt (July 5, 1917 – March 5, 2006) was an American econometrician. He was a long-time faculty member at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, and is known for developing the Cochrane–Orcutt estimation procedure. A native of Michigan, Orcutt earned his bachelor's, master's and doctorate degree from the University of Michigan. In 1959 he was elected as a Fellow of the American Statistical Association.
source.title: Guy Orcutt
